verdict: Yes, with honest materials claims. Studio Beej from Mumbai pitched sustainable, plant-based leather accessories on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Buyers want alternatives to animal leather and plastic-based vegan leather, but plant-based materials cost more and vary in quality.
angle: Leather alternatives made from plants, such as leaves or agricultural waste, appeal to ethical buyers. Test durability carefully and be clear about what's in the material, including any coatings.
